evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Framing a prod failure pattern is delivered in flat diagnostic register — low arousal, mildly negative valence of recounting a known defect.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Imperative 'must not' / 'must' carries urgent constraint pressure — high arousal, negative valence of a hard requirement guarding against failure.
